import sys

class Char:
    def __init__(self, chr, val, idx):
        self.chr = chr
        self.val = val
        self.idx = idx

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Char{{chr={self.chr}, val={self.val}, idx={self.idx}}}"

    def __eq__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Char):
            return self.chr == other.chr and self.val == other.val and self.idx == other.idx
        return False

    def __hash__(self):
        return hash((self.chr, self.val, self.idx))

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    s = data[1]
    vals = list(map(int, data[2:2+n]))
    
    chars = list(s)
    
    wrongChars = []
    chars1 = []
    for i in range(n // 2):
        if vals[i] > vals[n - i - 1]:
            tmp = chars[i]
            chars[i] = chars[n - i - 1]
            chars[n - i - 1] = tmp
            tmp_val = vals[i]
            vals[i] = vals[n - i - 1]
            vals[n - i - 1] = tmp_val
        
        chr_obj = Char(chars[i], vals[i], i)
        if chars[i] == chars[n - i - 1]:
            wrongChars.append(chr_obj)
        chars1.append(chr_obj)
    
    chars1.sort(key=lambda c: c.val)
    
    diff = 0
    if not isAntiPalindrome(chars):
        if len(wrongChars) == 1:
            wrongChar = wrongChars[0]
            for i in range(n // 2):
                chr_obj = chars1[i]
                if chr_obj.chr != wrongChar.chr and chars[n - chr_obj.idx - 1] != wrongChar.chr:
                    diff = wrongChar.val + chr_obj.val
                    break
        elif len(wrongChars) > 1:
            map_dict = {}
            for c in wrongChars:
                map_dict[c.chr] = map_dict.get(c.chr, 0) + 1
            max_entry = max(map_dict.items(), key=lambda x: x[1])
            max_char, max_count = max_entry
            append = []
            while max_count * 2 > len(wrongChars) + len(append):
                for i in range(n // 2):
                    chr_obj = chars1[i]
                    if (chr_obj.chr != max_char and
                        chars[n - chr_obj.idx - 1] != max_char and
                        chr_obj not in wrongChars and
                        chr_obj not in append):
                        append.append(chr_obj)
                        break
            diff = sum(c.val for c in wrongChars) + sum(c.val for c in append)
    
    total_sum = sum(vals)
    print(total_sum - diff)

def isAntiPalindrome(chars):
    n = len(chars)
    for i in range(n // 2):
        if chars[i] == chars[n - i - 1]:
            return False
    return True

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
